tool.name: OGS: identifySubdomains
tool.description: Checks if the subdomain meshes are part of the bulk mesh and writes the 'bulk_node_ids' and the 'bulk_element_ids' in each of them.
tool.command: #import re ln -sf '$mesh' 'mesh.vtu'; #set $safe_names = [re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) for $item in $subdomain_meshes_filenames] #if len($safe_names) != len(set($safe_names)) #set $joined = ', '.join($safe_names) echo 'error: the element identifiers map to the same file name after characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_.@-] are replaced by _: $joined' >&2; exit 1; #end if #for $item in $subdomain_meshes_filenames #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$item' '$safe_name'; #end for identifySubdomains $force #if str($searchlength) --searchlength '$searchlength' #end if --mesh 'mesh.vtu' --output_prefix new_ -- #for $item in $subdomain_meshes_filenames #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) '$safe_name' #end for

param.label: searchlength
param.help: search length determining radius for the node search algorithm. Non-negative floating point number

param.label: mesh
param.help: Input (.vtu). The file name of the bulk mesh

tool.help: Checks if the subdomain meshes are part of the bulk mesh and writes the 'bulk_node_ids' and the 'bulk_element_ids' in each of them. The documentation is available at https://www.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing-submeshes/identifysubdomains/.
